name: autodevops-bridge
description: Reusable GitHub workflow automation with explicit VSR and GHS production deployment modes.

interface.shortDescription: Safely deploy projects with VSR or GHS
interface.longDescription: Manage self-hosted projects through allow-listed GitHub workflows. VSR runs workflows on a VPS Self-hosted Runner; GHS deploys from a GitHub-hosted Runner through pinned SSH and rsync.
defaultPrompt: List my projects and show whether each one uses VSR or GHS.
Deploy the latest tested main release using the project's configured VSR or GHS mode.
Deploy the sumeme project using GHS mode.
Diagnose the latest failed deployment and state the configured ADOB mode.
Prepare a safe rollback and identify whether execution will use VSR or GHS.
